description: This file contains unit tests for the legacy tools-by-sender helper functions in a TypeScript project, using Vitest. It tests functions related to scanning, repairing, and warning about legacy data structures within a configuration object.

methods.name: collectLegacyToolsBySenderWarnings
methods.description: Generates warning messages related to legacy tools by sender keys, including untyped keys and explicit prefixes.

methods.name: maybeRepairLegacyToolsBySenderKeys
methods.description: Attempts to repair legacy tools by sender keys in the configuration, migrating untyped keys to typed id entries.

methods.name: scanLegacyToolsBySenderKeys
methods.description: Scans the configuration for legacy tools by sender keys and returns hits with paths and labels.
